assemble_seeded_fla_replay_inputs_r2.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import array
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import socket
import struct
import sys
import tarfile

assert socket.gethostname() == 'aitopatom-66c4' and sys.byteorder == 'little'
root = Path('<private-home>/qrt-gb10-seeded-suffix1024-20260912-r1')
case = 'long-prefix16384-suffix1024-out512'
capture = json.loads((root/'capture/capture.json').read_text())
oracle_path = root/'contracts/gb10_long_prefix16k_actual_tokens_20260912_oracle.json'
oracle = json.loads(oracle_path.read_text())
assert capture['completed'] and capture['controls_qualified']
assert capture['source_commit'] == 'd4170fd995fa0d811d27077876a466924d7c820d'
record = json.loads((root/'capture'/(case+'.json')).read_text())
gold = next(c for c in oracle['cases'] if c['name'] == case)
assert record['output_token_ids'] == gold['expected']['output_token_ids']
assert record['worker']['sha256'] == gold['raw_logits']['sha256']
boundaries = record['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
window = boundaries['full_prefill_linear_window']
assert window['plan'] == dict(layer=0, first_position=16384, tokens=1024)
assert window['transaction'] == 2 and len(window['labels']) == 17
transaction = next(t for t in boundaries['transactions'] if t['ordinal'] == 2)
assert transaction['first_position'] == 16384 and transaction['token_count'] == 1024
assert all(row['matches_generated_history'] for row in transaction['qualified_rows'])
token_bytes = b''.join(struct.pack('<I', x) for x in transaction['input_token_ids'])
assert hashlib.sha256(token_bytes).hexdigest() == json.loads((root/'prompt-lineage.json').read_text())['suffix']['u32le_sha256']
layout_source = Path('<private-home>/seeded-fla-layout-source-r2.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(layout_source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'bcce3501c8213a446895467e16180a0256d7b289d9317bde7549959e00029fd2'
assert 'Initial state of shape `[N, H, V, K]`' in layout_source.read_text()
out = root/'seeded-fla-replay-inputs-r2'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
sources = {}

def read(label, dtype, shape):
    meta = next(m for m in boundaries['files'].values() if m['transaction'] == 2 and
                m['label'] == 'full-prefill-linear-00-'+label)
    assert meta['dtype'] == dtype and meta['shape'] == shape
    p = root/'capture'/case/meta['file']
    data = p.read_bytes()
    assert len(data) == meta['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == meta['sha256']
    values = array.array('H' if dtype == 'bf16' else 'I'); values.frombytes(data)
    sources[label] = meta
    return values, data

q,_ = read('q-core-input','bf16',[1024,2048])
k,_ = read('k-core-input','bf16',[1024,2048])
v,_ = read('v-core-input','bf16',[1024,4096])
raw = array.array('I')
for row in range(1024):
    for values,width in ((q,2048),(k,2048),(v,4096)):
        raw.extend(int(x)<<16 for x in values[row*width:(row+1)*width])
(out/'raw-f32.bin').write_bytes(raw.tobytes())
g,_ = read('g-core-input','f32',[1024,32])
beta,_ = read('beta-core-input','bf16',[1024,32])
gates = array.array('I')
for row in range(1024):
    gates.extend(g[row*32:(row+1)*32])
    gates.extend(int(x)<<16 for x in beta[row*32:(row+1)*32])
(out/'gates-f32.bin').write_bytes(gates.tobytes())
for label,filename,dtype,shape in (
    ('initial-state','initial-value-major-f32.bin','f32',[1,32,128,128]),
    ('final-state','expected-value-major-f32.bin','f32',[1,32,128,128]),
    ('core','expected-output-bf16.bin','bf16',[1024,4096])):
    _,data = read(label,dtype,shape)
    (out/filename).write_bytes(data)
owner = json.loads((root/'capture/long-prefix16384-owner-out32.json').read_text())
owner_state = owner['worker']['runtime_boundaries']['files']['txn0001-linear-00-prefill-state-after-f32']
assert owner_state['sha256'] == sources['initial-state']['sha256']
files = {p.name:dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p)) for p in out.iterdir()}
manifest = dict(schema_version=2,host=socket.gethostname(),source_commit=capture['source_commit'],
    command_file=__file__,command_file_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
    capture_sha256=sha(root/'capture/capture.json'),case_sha256=sha(root/'capture'/(case+'.json')),
    oracle_sha256=sha(oracle_path),original_controls_pass=True,
    all_512_tokens_and_full_first_logits_match=True,case=case,
    model_reference=capture['model'],layer=0,prefix_tokens=16384,suffix_tokens=1024,
    suffix_u32le_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token_bytes).hexdigest(),initial_state_matches_independent_owner=True,
    state_layout='value_head_value_key_fp32',
    state_layout_source=dict(file=str(layout_source),sha256=sha(layout_source),
        original_path='fla/ops/chunk.py',reference_capture='qrt-gb10-prefix-control-boundaries-20260912-r1',
        initial_and_final_layout='N,H,V,K'),
    supersedes_diagnostic_fixture='seeded-fla-replay-inputs-r1',
    correction='Original state bytes preserved; r1 mislabeled V,K as K,V and selected the wrong interface.',raw_layout='token_q2048_k2048_v4096_fp32_exact_bf16_extension',
    gate_layout='token_g32_fp32_beta32_exact_bf16_extension',
    original_source_files=sources,independent_owner_state=owner_state,files=files,
    diagnostic_only=True,model_inference_acceptance=False)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
archive = root/'seeded-fla-replay-inputs-r2.tar'
assert not archive.exists()
with tarfile.open(archive,'w') as tar:
    for p in sorted(out.iterdir()):tar.add(p,arcname=p.name)
print(json.dumps(dict(archive=str(archive),bytes=archive.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(archive),
    manifest=manifest,manifest_sha256=sha(out/'manifest.json'))),flush=True)
